### How Optimistic Version Checks Prevent Lost Updates

In a high-concurrency environment (like an inventory system), multiple transactions may attempt to update the same record simultaneously. Without concurrency control, a "lost update" occurs when two transactions read the same value, both calculate a new value based on that old read
